meta_description:
61K likes, 83 comments - thevishnukaushal on February 15, 2025: "“I might not agree with what you say, but I shall always fight for your right to say it”, said voltaire. 

So grateful to the Human Rights Office of @unitednations for inviting, hosting and letting me dive deep into your work. Connecting with the brightest minds & seeing them work selflessly for the betterment of human life has been truly transformative. Hoping to take back and share this wisdom soon 🫶🏼 Going to nerd out on #HumanRightsEconomy 🙂‍↕️".
